_help: ADD YOUR LINKS HERE. Only add streams you have the right to watch. 'movies': TMDB movie id -> video URL (.mp4 or .m3u8). 'tv': TMDB show id -> URL template using {s} for season and {e} for episode, e.g. https://example.com/show/{s}/{e}.m3u8. 'live': list of channels; time and league are optional. Empty URLs are ignored.
